topic: What if Usopp never joined the Straw Hats at the end of the Syrup Village arc, and the crew had to survive Arlong Park and Enies Lobby one sniper short
title: What If Usopp Never Left Syrup Village?
description:
What if Usopp waves goodbye and stays home the day Luffy's crew sails off? No sniper, no Sogeking, no one to take the one shot that saves Nico Robin at Enies Lobby. Here's how far one scared kid's choice to stay actually reaches, chapter by chapter.

From Arlong Park to the Gates of Justice, this follows exactly what the Straw Hats lose, and what it costs them to survive without it, when their sniper never leaves home.
comment: Does the crew even make it off Enies Lobby alive without a sniper, or does Usopp's choice cost them everything?
